title: Anakin Skywalker
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: Anakin Skywalker. the pre-dark side Darth Vader, was revealed only at the climax of RETURN OF THE JEDI. The illustration from the Libby Perszyk Kathman studio (front, collection of Thomas H. Neiheisel) shows the ghostly apparition of actor Sebastian Shaw as he appeared at the very end of the film. The Anakin action figure was one of the last released by Kenner Products (back).
